matrix_meta.interpretation: L = D - A assembled from |values| (unit weights for a pattern file)
matrix_meta.cmg_input: the DUMPED L, re-derived from |off-diagonal| (identical to the dump for a kind=graph matrix) and shifted by reg_rel=1e-6*mean|diag| — CMG is the lone reg-rel solver and is scored on L+eps*I
